{'paragraph': '前白宮新聞秘書卡羅琳·萊維特週一試圖抨擊民主黨政治人物，但她的數字卻對不上。', 'translation': "Former White House Press Secretary Karoline Leavitt tried to slam Democratic politicians on Monday, but her numbers didn't add up."}

{'paragraph': '她在霍士新聞節目上發言時指出，民主黨人如詹姆斯·塔拉里科——該黨在德克薩斯州的參議院候選人——是「極度虛偽」。', 'translation': 'Speaking on a Fox News program, she pointed to Democrats like James Talarico — the party\'s Senate candidate in Texas — as being "the ultimate hypocrites."'}

{'paragraph': '她告訴主持人肖恩·漢尼提：「他們以溫和派姿態競選，但會在每一個政策立場上轉一個360度大圈，試圖爭取有常識、善良的美國人支持。然而，當他們當選後，施政卻完全是激進極端自由派狂熱分子。」', 'translation': 'She told host Sean Hannity: "They campaign as moderates, but they do a complete 360 on every single policy position, trying to appeal to common sense, good Americans. And then, when they get elected, they govern as radical, extreme liberal lunatics."'}

{'paragraph': '以溫和派姿態競選，卻在「每一個政策立場上轉360度」，意味着他們施政時也會是溫和派，因為轉360度正好讓人回到原點。', 'translation': 'Campaigning as a moderate while doing a "complete 360 on every single policy position" would mean governing as a moderate, since a 360-degree turn lands you exactly where you started.'}
